description: Trigger a Shuffle SOAR workflow on high-severity escalations. Shuffle can then isolate endpoints, create tickets, or notify on-call engineers automatically.

params.note: High-severity alert escalated — Shuffle workflow triggered for automated response.

params.body: Shuffle SOAR workflow triggered for automated response. Check Shuffle dashboard for execution status.
Investigation auto-closed by triage policy. No Shuffle workflow triggered.

setup: 1. In Shuffle: create a workflow with a Webhook trigger
2. Copy the webhook URL from Shuffle → Workflows → Triggers → Webhook
3. In SocTalk Settings → Integrations → Shuffle: paste the webhook URL
4. Optional: set shuffle_webhook_secret in tenant policy for HMAC verification
5. Change status from 'shadow' to 'active' when ready
shuffle_callback: Configure your Shuffle workflow to POST results back to SocTalk:
what_shuffle_can_do: Send Slack/Teams alert to security channel
